 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bangladesh will hope to come back stronger in their second and final Test against West Indies at Sylhet, starting November 5.
 The tourists lead the series 1-0 following an eight-wicket win in the first Test in Mirpur. Jomel Warrican took nine wickets, while Brandon King and John Campbell guided them to an easy victory, reaching the 170 runs target by Day 4.

 West Indies are looking to build on their good form and win the Test series, having beaten Sri Lanka 1-0 and drawn 1-1 against Pakistan earlier this year, while the hosts will need to put up an all-round display to even things out in the series.

 What time does Bangladesh vs. West Indies 2nd Test start?
 The second Test between Bangladesh and West Indies will be played at Sylhet International Cricket Stadium in Sylhet, Bangladesh.
 Play is scheduled to begin at 9:30 a.m. local time (BST - Bangladesh Standard Time), which translates to 9:00 a.m. IST on Thursday, November 5 , for viewers in India .
 MORE: Bangladesh vs. West Indies 2nd Test prediction, pitch report and more 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bangladesh vs. West Indies 2nd Test team news, lineups
 Bangladesh's Mominul Haque is not available because of a concussion during the first Test, with Amite Hasan replacing him in the squad. Mushfiqur Rahim can play if he is ready following an injury to his finger.
 Bangladesh predicted XI: Shadman Islam, Tanzid Hasan, Najmul Hossain Shanto (c), Towhid Hridoy, Litton Das (wk), Mehidy Hasan Miraz, Nayeem Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Taijul Islam, Taskin Ahmed, Hasan Mahmud.
 The Windies are likely to largely field the same side which won the first Test. Both Jomel Warrican and Roston Chase are key members in the spin department of their team while Brandon King and John Campbell should continue as the opening pair.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement West Indies predicted XI: Brandon King, John Campbell, Tagenarine Chanderpaul, Kavem Hodge, Amir Jangoo (wk), Justin Greaves, Roston Chase (c), Jomel Warrican, Shamar Joseph, Jayden Seales, Joshua Bishop.
